title: DR3 Gas Dryer
lead: The DR3 is the Speed Queen dryer at its simplest: four cycles, three temperatures, a Sanitize cycle, and a moisture sensor that stops the heat when the load is dry. The same 7.0 cu. ft. galvanized cylinder as the models above it.

features.name: Sanitize
features.line: A Sanitize cycle for bedding, towels and whatever else needs more than dry. Speed Queen says it kills bacteria.

features.name: Dries to the sensor, not the clock
features.line: A moisture sensor ends the cycle when the load is dry, and Speed Queen's Commercial Cool-Down brings the temperature down before the drum stops.

features.name: Extended Tumble
features.line: Keeps the load moving after the cycle ends, so it is not sitting in its own creases when you get to it.

features.name: Four cycles, three temperatures
features.line: Controls anyone in the house can read at a glance, in front of a 7.0 cu. ft. galvanized cylinder.

features.name: Three years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the DR3 with a 3-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

also: 22,500 BTU gas burner; converts to LP with Speed Queen's kit, sold separately
Up-front lint filter with a filter guard
